summary: Tuple-struct deserialization discarded the supplied field count and called deserialize_seq, incorrectly consuming payload bytes as a varint length even though tuple-struct serialization writes no length prefix. The fix calls deserialize_tuple(len, visitor). A verbatim reversal is available, but no detecting upstream test was found at this revision. The fix adds no tests; de::test::structs and the loopback integration test use TupleStruct((u8, u16)), a single-field newtype that exercises deserialize_newtype_struct and deserialize_tuple instead of deserialize_tuple_struct. The candidate is blocked by the missing detecting test; no tests were executed.
